Contact Explorer Android APK

File: ContactExplorer-Android.apk

Install on phone:
1. Copy the APK to your Android phone.
2. Open it from Files/Downloads.
3. Allow "Install unknown apps" if Android asks.
4. Install and open Contact Explorer.
5. Grant Contacts permission when prompted to read or edit phone contacts.

Build details:
- Application: Contact Explorer
- Version: 6.0 (versionCode 6)
- Minimum Android: API 26 / Android 8.0
- Target Android: API 35
- SHA-256: 01B65422CB3343B09945E8BF7BF414CF14D4B77E96620599E4A7C5D136A68B1

Note: Tkinter is a desktop-only UI toolkit and cannot run directly inside an
Android APK. This APK is the Android-compatible native build of the Contact
Explorer feature set; the Python/Tkinter project remains available for Windows.
